summary: Customer C08106 reported an unrecognized online purchase of $128.33 (transaction T3583227) made via a new device profile. The customer has a history of 4 prior closed fraud cases, supporting a high probability of account compromise. The transaction originated from a new desktop device using Firefox 47.0.
